{'test_code': '@Test\npublic void testSkipValueRefillsBufferAndThrowsEOFWhenReaderExhaustedInsideArray() throws Exception {\n    // Input ends right after the array open so doPeek() must inspect the next token,\n    // nextNonWhitespace(true) must attempt to refill, and fillBuffer(1) returns false.\n    JsonReader reader = new JsonReader(new java.io.StringReader("["));\n\n    try {\n        reader.beginArray();\n        fail("Expected EOFException");\n    } catch (EOFException expected) {\n        assertTrue(expected.getMessage().contains("End of input"));\n    } finally {\n        reader.close();\n    }\n}\n', 'test_name': 'testSkipValueRefillsBufferAndThrowsEOFWhenReaderExhaustedInsideArray', 'test_behavior': 'Verifies that parsing inside an array reaches nextNonWhitespace(true), attempts buffer refill at EOF, and throws EOFException when fillBuffer(1) fails.', 'new_imports_code': 'import static org.junit.Assert.assertTrue;\nimport static org.junit.Assert.fail;\nimport java.io.EOFException;'}
